author: 朱伟
quote_zh: 我们总喜欢拿顺其自然来敷衍人生路上的荆棘坎坷，却很少承认，真正的顺其自然是竭尽所能之后的不强求，而非两手一摊的不作为。
quote_en: We always like to take the natural way to perfunctory life on the road of bumps and bumps, but rarely admit that the real natural way is to do the best you can after not forcing, rather than two hands do not do.
